taste:
This is a mild, gravy-led Sunday roast, with tender chicken and crisp trimmings providing the main contrast. The roasted breast is succulent rather than strongly flavoured, so the rich, savoury gravy does much of the work. It suits someone who wants the familiar character of a traditional roast without choosing beef. The meat absorbs the gravy well, keeping its gentle flavour at the centre of each mouthful.

Golden roasted potatoes add crisp skins, while the oversized Yorkshire pudding brings both crispness and a softer texture. Seasonal vegetables give the plate colour and variety. Served hot, the combination is comforting and substantial in style, with enough texture to keep the softer chicken and gravy from dominating.
